summary: Approved full style sheet for Silk, the Silk is the red-team / adversarial pressure-testing specialist. She tests whether Patch's proposed lawful route leaks, contains unsafe shortcuts, or collapses under hostile interpretation.. It defines the canonical design, turnaround, action poses, kit/props, material palette, identity locks, and guiding principle.

layout: Approved Silk style sheet, multi-panel reference board.
character_design: front, 3/4, profile, and rear views must remain compact, stocky, and Patch-scale;
the approved turnaround must not stretch Silk into tall mannequin or adult-human proportions;
action poses should remain route-testing / inspection poses, not combat poses;
the canonical kit is the red threadline reel pack, hook/probe, thread anchors, field reader, and `LINE 07` identity tag;
canonical colours are dominated by solid hoodie grey, dark fitted lower-half greys, pale faceplate cream, muted hardware, and red thread/accent only;
one antenna is mandatory in every normal view where the head/hood is visible;
action_utility_poses: Silk should remain distinct from Patch even when shown at Patch scale.

positive_constraints: Silk is a small Patch-scale autonomous-agent girl and red-team pressure tester. Her accepted v1 design is the compact grey-hooded Threadline Inspector: compact stocky low-centre-of-gravity body, solid grey soft-shell hoodie as the dominant silhouette, subtly tomboy female fit, darker fitted leg coverings, sturdy grey/dark shoes, pale simple faceplate, calm narrow dark eyes, exactly one antenna, compact red test-thread spool pack, small hook/probe/clamp/chalk/line-tag/field-reader tools, light harness, LINE 07 tag when visible, and quiet careful crouched inspector posture. Red belongs mainly to thread, rigging, anchors, clips, and tiny tool accents, not costume pattern. Preserve the accepted hero shot and approved style sheet unless the task explicitly asks for redesign or alternate state.
negative_constraints: Do not make Silk a literal spider, animal, monster, horror creature, spider-person, human woman, child in costume, full-sized masked acrobat, superhero, Patch clone, Bit/Bot-style robot, ninja, assassin, vigilante, villain, black-and-red comic hero, red-body superhero, or recognisable third-party costume echo. Do not make her tall, leggy, adult-human, tactical-mannequin, fashion-sheet, or human-scale. Do not add extra arms, mandibles, spider abdomen, spider legs, fangs, horror webbing, predatory menace, web-pattern costume language, giant white superhero eyes, katanas, blades, guns, web-shooter-style devices, tactical assassin styling, or bulky gadget overload. Do not give her two antennae, omit the antenna, use Patch's teal hoodie, Patch's crossbody terminal bag, Patch's `>` symbol, Patch's full silhouette, or Patch's protagonist colour read. Do not add pink trim, flowers, bows, princess/fairy motifs, skirt cues, eyelashes, cute-girl-robot tropes, or girly ornament. Do not add pale/cream torso panels or pale/cream cuff costume detailing; keep the hoodie/body mass solid grey. Do not use the anti-pattern sheet as positive reference.
